experiments.title: Give a badge an expiry date before it was issued
experiments.plain: The first badge in the database is made to expire on 1 January 2020, years before it was issued.
experiments.predict: Will the very first public release still go out? What happens to the "latest" pointer?
experiments.look_for: Validation blocks the first release and names the badge, so no file ever goes live and the pointer never moves.

edits.sql: UPDATE badge SET expiry_date = '2020-01-01' WHERE row_id = 1

diff.text: == 2. First release: validate, publish, verify over HTTP, then move the pointer

release R0001: BLOCKED  (268 badges, sha256 69d3f1d032e8)

experiments.title: Issue a badge of a type that does not exist
experiments.plain: The first badge's type is changed to GLASS-WIZARD, which is not in the badge_type table.
experiments.predict: The database does not enforce this link on its own here. Does the pipeline still catch it?
experiments.look_for: The release is blocked by controlled_vocabulary, naming the badge and the type GLASS-WIZARD. (This experiment found a real bug - the badge used to vanish silently from the file - and the fix is covered by a test.)

edits.sql: UPDATE badge SET badge_type = 'GLASS-WIZARD' WHERE row_id = 1
